description: This file defines API endpoints for managing repairs within a web application using FastAPI. It includes routes for creating, listing, retrieving details, updating, assigning technicians, and changing repair status, with role-based access controls.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router class used to define groupings of API endpoints.

classes.name: RepairService
classes.description: Service class handling business logic related to repair operations.

methods.name: RepairService _svc()
methods.description: Internal helper to instantiate the RepairService with a database client.

methods.name: bool _has_role(user: CurrentUser, role: Role)
methods.description: Check if the current user has a specific role.

methods.name: None _assert_can_view_repair(user: CurrentUser, repair: RepairRead)
methods.description: Ensure the user has permission to view a specific repair.

methods.name: RepairRead create_repair( payload: RepairCreate, user: CurrentUser = Depends(require_role(Role.customer, Role.admin)), )
methods.description: API endpoint for creating a new repair request (customer or admin).

methods.name: AdminRepairsSummary repairs_admin_summary( recent_limit: int = 10, _: CurrentUser = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)) )
methods.description: Get a summary of repairs for admin dashboard.

methods.name: RepairsListResponse list_repairs(user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: List repairs scoped to the role of the current user.

methods.name: RepairDetail get_repair_detail( repair_id: str, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific repair, with role-based access control.

methods.name: RepairRead patch_repair( repair_id: str, payload: RepairUpdate, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Update specific fields of a repair, respecting user permissions.

methods.name: RepairRead assign_technician( repair_id: str, payload: RepairAssignRequest, user: CurrentUser = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), )
methods.description: Assign a technician to a repair, admin only.

methods.name: RepairStatusHistoryItem change_repair_status( repair_id: str, payload: RepairStatusChangeRequest, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Change the status of a repair, allowed for technicians and admins.

ctags.signature: ( repair_id: str, payload: RepairAssignRequest, user: CurrentUser = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), )

ctags.signature: ( repair_id: str, payload: RepairStatusChangeRequest, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user) )

ctags.name: create_repair
